text:
Jasmine Park: hello everyone! i'm jasmine, starting today as an ML infra PM. pronouns she/her. i split time between seattle and SF, but i'll be in the office next Tuesday. tiny confession: i'm obsessed with mooncakes and bonsai. here for the snacks and the plants. :moon_cake: :seedling: 
Theo: welcome jasmine!! mooncakes and bonsai are an elite combo. if you're in SF next tuesday come say hi at the east window desks, we usually have bagels. :bagel: 
Maya: hi jasmine 1 so glad you're here! we do a quick "two-min intros" standup on Mondays in #watercooler at 9:15am PT; feel free to drop in remotely. also we have a plant adoption corner on Fridays if you want to rescue a ficus.
Ben (IT): Jasmine 1 badge/email/provisioning done. your badge will be at reception; if you need a temporary guest badge before pickup let me know. Also, standing desk requests are handled here 1 reply with "stand" and i'll queue it.
Jasmine Park: thanks Ben! please queue a stand. also, what is the best place to buy mooncakes nearby? my friend recommended a bakery but names escape me.
Luca: welcome! try Golden Lotus bakery on 3rd 1 they do a great lotus paste one. also, if you bring mooncakes to the office i will officially volunteer as taste-tester. :raised_hands: 
Theo: also FYI we have a monthly "snack-and-share" where people bring homemade things. next one is the 18th. perfect for mooncake deployment.
Maya: hey jasmine, sending you an invite to a 1:1 coffee chat next week so we can intro properly. and pls bring bonsai tips 1 i have been meaning to keep a succulent alive for longer than a week.
Jasmine Park: sold on the Golden Lotus rec, putting it on my list. thanks for the warm welcome everyone 1 excited to be here! :wave:
welcome-bot: Onboarding checklist updated for Jasmine Park 1 badge_assigned, welcome_message_sent.
Ben (IT): Stand desk request queued. ETA 3 business days for setup.
Luca: see you next week! mooncake + bonsai swap when you're in. :seedling::moon_cake:
